name: Day 48 Solution: AI Agent Monitoring
description: Agent monitoring system that pulls real recent executions from n8n's own REST API, computes a real weighted health score in a Code node, and — only when the score is below threshold — sends a real Slack alert with the failing detail; either way the check is logged to Airtable for trend history.

parameters.content:
## Day 48 Solution: AI Agent Monitoring

Calls n8n's own REST API for recent executions, computes a real weighted 0-100 health score in a Code node (successRate*0.6 + durationScore*0.4), then an IF node gates the result: below threshold sends a real Slack alert naming the failing execution and its error; at/above threshold just records "healthy". Either branch logs the check to Airtable so you can see trend over time.

**What changed from the audited version:** the six fake HTTP calls to `api.performance-monitor.com`, `api.health-monitor.com`, `api.availability-monitor.com`, `api.error-monitor.com`, `api.monitoring-service.com`, and `api.monitoring-log.com` are gone. In their place: one real HTTP Request node calling `https://n8n-takumi.onrender.com/api/v1/executions`, a real Code node computing the health score, a real IF node gating on that score (added — the audited version computed a score but never branched on it), a real Slack alert node, and a real Airtable logging node.

**Credentials needed to run for real:** an n8n API key credential — create a **Header Auth** credential named e.g. "n8n API Key" with header name `X-N8N-API-KEY` and your key as the value (n8n Settings → API), then attach it to the "Get Recent Executions" node's Authentication field. Slack OAuth2 for the alert node. Airtable Personal Access Token for the history log.

See DAILY_TASKS/DAY_48_AI_Agent_Monitoring.md for the full lesson this solves.

## ✅ Real, testable metrics source

This node replaces the four fake "Collect * Metrics" calls to `api.performance-monitor.com` / `api.health-monitor.com` / `api.availability-monitor.com` / `api.error-monitor.com` with one real call to n8n's own Executions API.

**Setup required:** create a **Header Auth** credential (Credentials → New → Header Auth) named `X-N8N-API-KEY`, value = your n8n API key from Settings → API, then attach it to this node's Authentication (Generic Credential Type → Header Auth) field after import.

## ✅ Real, testable alert + logging

The Slack node replaces the fake "Send Monitoring Results" call; the Airtable node replaces the fake "Log Monitoring Activity" call (both used to hit `api.monitoring-service.com` / `api.monitoring-log.com`). The IF node gating the alert is new — the audited version computed a health score but never branched on it.
